content.text: Jump to content Coordinates: 40°53′38″N 72°26′24″W / 40.894°N 72.440°W / 40.894; -72.440 From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Golf tournament Golf tournament2026 U.S. OpenTournament informationDatesJune 18–21, 2026LocationSouthampton, New York40°53′38″N 72°26′24″W / 40.894°N 72.440°W / 40.894; -72.440CourseShinnecock Hills Golf ClubOrganized byUSGATour(s)PGA TourEuropean TourJapan Golf TourStatisticsField156 playersLocation mapShinnecock Hills GCLocation in the United StatesShinnecock Hills GCLocation in New YorkShow map of the United StatesShow map of New YorkShow both← 20252027 → The 2026 United States Open Championship will be the 126th edition of the U.S. Open, the national open golf championship of the United States. It will be held from June 18–21, 2026 at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club in Southampton, New York. It will be the sixth Open hosted at the club.[1][2] References[edit] ^ Dickson, Ben (September 15, 2025). "U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills in 2026 will be a demanding test". Newsday. Retrieved October 1, 2025. ^ Kelly, Todd (April 23, 2025). "Future U.S. Open venues include Shinnecock Hills, hosting for an sixth time in 2026". Golfweek. Retrieved October 1, 2025.
